parent_channels.name: Devotional Dependence and Rule
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A dependent community turns toward a sovereign divine addressee through worship, service, obedience, and petition.

subchannels.active_motifs: worship as an act `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; the worshipped deity `ء ل ه:B001/m02`; obedient religious submission `د ي ن:B001/m01`; humble worship and service `ع ب د:B003/m01`
subchannels.name: Worship and Obedient Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worshippers direct humble obedience to the one recognized as deity and organizing religious authority.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene joins the divine object of worship to the human act of worship, then specifies the relation as obedience enacted with humility. Religion is active here as an ordering relation rather than merely a named doctrine.

subchannels.active_motifs: divine lordship `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; proprietary mastery `ر ب ب:B001/m02`; kingship and sovereignty `م ل ك:B003/m01`; ownership and disposal of property `م ل ك:B002/m01`; the enslaved dependent `ع ب د:B001/m01`; coercive dominion `د ي ن:B004/m01`; the honored or venerated servant `ع ب د:B006/m01`
subchannels.name: Sovereignty, Ownership, and Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: A lord and king possesses a domain, governs it, and stands over dependents whose service ranges from honored attendance to enslavement.
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship and kingship supply the governing agent, ownership supplies the legal relation to a domain, and servitude supplies the dependent role. The honored servant and the enslaved subject expose opposite social realizations of the same vertical relation.

subchannels.active_motifs: requested aid and cooperation `ع و ن:B001/m01`; gentle guidance `ه د ي:B001/m01`; the traversable path `ص ر ط:B001/m01`; uprightness and rectitude `ق و م:B008/m01`; mercy enacted as benefaction `ر ح م:B001/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ` (`ر ح م`); 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱهْدِنَا`, `ٱلصِّرَٰطَ`, and `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ه د ي`, `ص ر ط`, `ق و م`); 1:7 `صِرَٰطَ` (`ص ر ط`)
subchannels.name: Petition for Aid and Direction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dependents seek assistance and gentle direction toward an upright path, with compassionate benefaction as the answering function.
subchannels.synthesis: Aid supplies the enabling force, guidance supplies the directing action, the path supplies its object, and straightness supplies the desired state. Mercy turns the request-response structure into beneficent rather than merely administrative rule.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The devotional relation extends lexically from willing worship into ownership and coercive service, while lordship also carries the countervailing function of nurture.

parent_channels.name: Benefaction, Welfare, and Praise
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Good is conferred through compassion and maintenance, stabilized as welfare, and answered by praise or recognition.

subchannels.active_motifs: tenderness and compassion `ر ح م:B001/m01`; beneficent mercy `ر ح م:B001/m02`; conferred blessing `ن ع م:B001/m02`; good condition `ن ع م:B001/m01`; progressive nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; guardianship and care `ق و م:B004/m01`; provision for dependents `غ ي ر:B001/m01`; repair of their equipment `غ ي ر:B001/m03`; practical aid `ع و ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.name: Compassionate Provision and Nurture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caregiver feels tenderness, nurtures a dependent over time, guards its affairs, and supplies or repairs what sustains a good condition.
subchannels.synthesis: Compassion is the motive, progressive nurture and guardianship are the continuing operations, and food, equipment, and assistance are the practical means. Blessing names the resulting condition of the cared-for dependent.

subchannels.active_motifs: aid and mutual support `ع و ن:B001/m01`; the mainstay of an affair `م ل ك:B005/m01`; structural and livelihood support `ق و م:B009/m01`; benefaction or favor `ن ع م:B001/m02`; blessing as a conferred good `ر ب ب:B016/m03`; seeking praise for a favor `ح م د:B005/m01`
subchannels.name: Patronage, Support, and Claimed Recognition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A patron supplies aid and the mainstay of another's life, then may present that support as a favor deserving praise.
subchannels.synthesis: Aid, mainstay, and livelihood form one support mechanism. The social relation becomes patronage when the giver converts that material dependence into a demand for acknowledgment.

subchannels.active_motifs: praise and thanks `ح م د:B001/m01`; knowledge and recognition `ع ل م:B001/m01`; learned cultivation of knowledge `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; a person marked by many praised qualities `ح م د:B003/m01`; verbal approval `ن ع م:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:2 `ٱلْحَمْدُ`, `رَبِّ`, and `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ح م د`, `ر ب ب`, `ع ل م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` (`ن ع م`)
subchannels.name: Knowing and Articulating the Praiseworthy
subchannels.scene_or_process: Knowledge discerns a benefit or admirable quality and renders that recognition as praise, approval, or an honored name.
subchannels.synthesis: Knowledge supplies discriminating recognition, learned cultivation stabilizes that judgment, and praise gives it public form. The result can attach either to an act of benefaction or to a person whose qualities make the praise durable.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Tenderness expands into practical provisioning, repair, guardianship, and structural support, while praise can function either as gratitude or as a claim imposed by a patron.

parent_channels.name: Declared Identity and Public Presence
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Names, utterances, reputation, and bearing make identity or commitment socially legible.

subchannels.active_motifs: name and naming `س م و:B005/m01`; a namesake or comparable bearer of a name `س م و:B005/m02`; the divine name `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; oath and vocative formulas using that name `ء ل ه:B002/m02`
subchannels.name: Naming, Invocation, and Direct Address
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker identifies the addressee by name and turns that name into invocation, oath, or direct appeal.
subchannels.synthesis: Naming establishes reference, while oath and vocative use convert reference into an active relation between speaker and addressee. The namesake motif defines identity comparatively by asking who else can bear the same designation.

subchannels.active_motifs: affirmative response `ن ع م:B004/m01`; certification or delegated judgment `د ي ن:B007/m01`; otherness and difference `غ ي ر:B005/m01`; exception and negation `غ ي ر:B005/m02`; the approximating or quantifying particle `ر ب ب:B015/m01`
subchannels.name: Assent, Certification, and Qualification
subchannels.scene_or_process: An utterance confirms a claim, delegates judgment, or narrows it through difference, exception, negation, and approximation.
subchannels.synthesis: Assent commits the speaker, certification authorizes another's word or judgment, and qualification sets the limits of the commitment. Approximation and exception show that discourse governs not only truth but also scope.

subchannels.active_motifs: good reputation or public voice `س م و:B008/m01`; social eminence `س م و:B001/m02`; exchanged praise or satire in verse `ه د ي:B011/m01`; the person of many praised qualities `ح م د:B003/m01`; soliciting praise for favors `ح م د:B005/m01`
subchannels.name: Reputation and Poetic Exchange
subchannels.scene_or_process: Public speech circulates praise or blame until it becomes a person's audible reputation and social eminence.
subchannels.synthesis: Poetic exchange is the transmitting action, praise and satire supply opposite evaluations, and public voice is the resulting social state. Eminence describes the vertical effect of a reputation that others cannot easily match.

subchannels.active_motifs: captain or chief of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; perfume brazier `ع ب د:B012/m01`; calm and dignified bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; good public reputation `س م و:B008/m01`; an elevated visible figure `س م و:B002/m01`
subchannels.name: The Reputed Captain's Ceremonial Bearing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maritime captain appears as a composed, publicly reputed leader whose station is marked by ceremonial scent.
subchannels.synthesis: The captain supplies the leading role, calm bearing and visibility make that role perceptible, reputation carries it beyond the immediate crew, and the perfume brazier gives the scene a ceremonial object of status.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The naming and address field reaches from divine invocation into assent, grammatical qualification, poetic exchange, and the ceremonial presence of a reputed captain.

parent_channels.name: Orientation, Passage, and Breakdown
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement is organized by a course, a guide, and a state of passage, then tested by deviation, engulfment, or loss of mobility.

subchannels.active_motifs: gentle route guidance `ه د ي:B001/m01`; direction and manner `ه د ي:B002/m01`; road or straight path `ص ر ط:B001/m01`; straightness and rectitude `ق و م:B008/m01`; route landmark and boundary `ع ل م:B002/m02`; middle of the road or valley `م ل ك:B006/m01`; paved or trodden road `ع ب د:B005/m01`; established custom or habitual course `د ي ن:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:2 `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ع ل م`); 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` and `ٱلدِّينِ` (`م ل ك`, `د ي ن`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 `ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ه د ي`, `ص ر ط`, `ق و م`); 1:7 `صِرَٰطَ` (`ص ر ط`)
subchannels.name: The Marked and Straight Route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler receives guidance, reads landmarks, enters the center of a prepared road, and maintains a straight course that can also become an established manner of conduct.
subchannels.synthesis: Guidance initiates movement, landmarks and boundaries make the route legible, a prepared surface and centerline stabilize traversal, and straightness describes its successful geometry. Direction and custom extend the same course structure from travel into sustained conduct.

subchannels.active_motifs: the foremost guide `ه د ي:B003/m01`; the leading animal followed by the group `م ل ك:B008/m01`; an elevated visible figure `س م و:B002/m01`; a gathered wild-cattle herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; a herd of wild donkeys `ع و ن:B006/m01`
subchannels.name: The Visible Leader at the Front
subchannels.scene_or_process: A conspicuous leader takes the foremost position and draws a herd or procession behind it.
subchannels.synthesis: Visibility allows the leader to be tracked, the foremost position supplies direction, and the gathered animals supply the following participants. Leadership is thus rendered as a spatial relation before it becomes a social one.

subchannels.active_motifs: swallowing and disappearance through a passage `ص ر ط:B002/m01`; disappearance or burial within another medium `ض ل ل:B002/m01`; a stallion rising over and entering the herd `س م و:B003/m01`; a cutting, penetrating sword `ص ر ط:B003/m01`
subchannels.name: Engulfing and Penetrating Passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: An entity enters, cuts through, or is swallowed by another body or medium until it becomes hidden.
subchannels.synthesis: Swallowing, mounting, cutting, and burial share a directional transition across a boundary. Their common outcome is loss of exterior visibility, whether the receiving medium is a throat, a body, or the earth.

subchannels.active_motifs: an exhausted or broken-down mount `ع ب د:B011/m01`; an animal halted by fatigue `ق و م:B016/m02`; swaying supported walking `ه د ي:B008/m01`; balanced mature strength `ع و ن:B005/m01`; quick running `ع ب د:B009/m02`; brief delay before action `ع ب د:B009/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` and `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع ب د`, `ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱهْدِنَا` and `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ه د ي`, `ق و م`)
subchannels.name: Halted, Supported, and Recovered Movement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A moving body weakens or stops, relies on external support, and may recover enough strength to resume at a different pace.
subchannels.synthesis: Fatigue produces the halt, supporting companions temporarily replace lost balance, and restored strength changes the pace from delay to renewed movement. The scene distinguishes inability, assistance, and recovery as successive states.

subchannels.active_motifs: deviation from guidance and aim `ض ل ل:B001/m01`; a possession whose location is lost `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; loss from memory `ض ل ل:B004/m01`; the ownerless stray animal `ض ل ل:B005/m01`; the dull or weak would-be guide `ه د ي:B009/m01`
subchannels.name: Disorientation, Forgetting, and the Stray
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler, object, memory, or animal loses its intended relation to a route, owner, or knower.
subchannels.synthesis: The invariant is failed relational placement. A person loses the intended course, an object loses its owner or known location, knowledge leaves memory, and an animal leaves recognized custody.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The straight-road scene expands into landmarks, centerlines, and leading animals, while swallowing, mounting, cutting, and burial supply a shape-motion analogy for passage into disappearance.

parent_channels.name: Time, Measure, and Final Reckoning
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Time is made intelligible by bounded spans and celestial positions, by pace within a duration, and by a culminating event of judgment.

subchannels.active_motifs: bounded daylight `ي و م:B001/m01`; the sun standing at midday `ق و م:B017/m01`; the overhead sky `س م و:B004/m01`; a lunar station `ن ع م:B007/m04`; a distinguishing sign `ع ل م:B002/m01`
subchannels.name: Daylight, Zenith, and Celestial Marking
subchannels.scene_or_process: A daylight span is located by the sun at zenith and by visible signs in the overhead sky.
subchannels.synthesis: Daylight supplies the bounded interval, zenith gives it an internal midpoint, and sky signs provide a larger celestial coordinate system. Time is read through the positions of bodies that appear to stand overhead.

subchannels.active_motifs: an open duration of time `ي و م:B002/m01`; brief delay `ع ب د:B009/m01`; quick running `ع ب د:B009/m02`; increase or intensification `ن ع م:B010/m01`; the utmost praised goal `ح م د:B004/m01`; calm bearing `ه د ي:B010/m01`; continued residence `ر ب ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.name: Duration, Pace, and Praised Attainment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor inhabits a duration, varies between delay and haste, intensifies effort, and reaches a praiseworthy limit without losing composure.
subchannels.synthesis: Duration supplies the field, delay and running supply contrasting rates, and intensification directs those rates toward an upper limit. Continued residence and calm bearing keep attainment from collapsing into mere haste.

subchannels.active_motifs: the momentous or calamitous day `ي و م:B003/m01`; resurrection and rising of creation `ق و م:B013/m01`; judgment, account, and recompense `د ي ن:B002/m01`; sovereign kingship `م ل ك:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ` (`م ل ك`, `ي و م`, `د ي ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`)
subchannels.name: The Momentous Day of Rising and Account
subchannels.scene_or_process: A climactic event arrives, creation rises, and a sovereign conducts judgment, accounting, and recompense.
subchannels.synthesis: The day is not only a duration but the event that triggers rising. Resurrection supplies the participants, sovereignty supplies the judge, and account and recompense supply the operation and outcome.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The day expands from ordinary daylight into zenith, lunar marking, personal pace, prolonged residence, and finally the event in which creation rises for sovereign accounting.

parent_channels.name: Property, Measure, and Legitimate Transfer
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Goods and obligations move between parties through ownership, valuation, replacement, compensation, gift, or offering.

subchannels.active_motifs: debt, loan, and deferred sale `د ي ن:B003/m01`; valuation and pricing `ق و م:B010/m01`; an equal-weight coin `ق و م:B015/m01`; a flourishing market `ق و م:B018/m01`; property and ownership `م ل ك:B002/m01`; livestock wealth `ن ع م:B005/m01`; an ownerless stray animal `ض ل ل:B005/m01`; a middle-aged animal fit for classification `ع و ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` and `ٱلدِّينِ` (`م ل ك`, `د ي ن`); 1:5 `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` and `ٱلضَّآلِّينَ` (`ن ع م`, `ض ل ل`)
subchannels.name: Credit, Price, and Livestock Property
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock is owned, priced, sold on credit, and monitored for loss within an active market.
subchannels.synthesis: Ownership identifies the goods, age and kind make animals assessable, pricing and equal coin establish measure, and debt permits delayed settlement. The stray is the failure case in which market property loses recognized custody.

subchannels.active_motifs: blood money or indemnity `غ ي ر:B002/m01`; replacement of one thing by another `غ ي ر:B003/m02`; standing in another's place `ق و م:B007/m01`; blood lost without vengeance or compensation `ض ل ل:B003/m02`; judgment and recompense `د ي ن:B002/m01`; transfer of ownership `م ل ك:B002/m02`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ ... ٱلدِّينِ` (`م ل ك`, `د ي ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `غَيْرِ` and `ٱلضَّآلِّينَ` (`غ ي ر`, `ض ل ل`)
subchannels.name: Replacement, Indemnity, and Redress
subchannels.scene_or_process: A lost or injured claim is answered by a substitute, transfer, or assessed compensation rather than remaining without redress.
subchannels.synthesis: Loss creates a vacant claim, substitution fills the vacant place, ownership transfer legalizes the replacement, and judgment fixes its compensatory value. Unredressed blood marks the opposite outcome.

subchannels.active_motifs: affectionate gift-giving `ه د ي:B004/m01`; conferred benefit `ن ع م:B001/m02`; mercy enacted as benefaction `ر ح م:B001/m02`; transfer into another's ownership `م ل ك:B002/m02`
subchannels.name: Reciprocal Gift and Beneficent Transfer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gift moves toward a valued recipient as an expression of affection, mercy, or benefit.
subchannels.synthesis: Affection supplies the social motive, the gift supplies the transferred object, ownership change completes the act, and benefaction names its intended effect on the recipient.

subchannels.active_motifs: consecrated offering to the sanctuary `ه د ي:B005/m01`; livestock wealth `ن ع م:B005/m01`; the worshipped deity `ء ل ه:B001/m02`; worshipful submission `ع ب د:B003/m01`
subchannels.name: Consecrated Offering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock or goods are selected from owned wealth and directed toward the sanctuary as an act of worship.
subchannels.synthesis: Livestock supplies the transferable material, consecration fixes its destination, and worship supplies the relation that distinguishes an offering from an ordinary gift.

parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 1:1 and 1:2 `ٱللَّهِ`, 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ`, 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ ... ٱلدِّينِ`, 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ`, 1:6 `ٱهْدِنَا ... ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ`, and 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ ... غَيْرِ ... ٱلضَّآلِّينَ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Financial debt and equal coinage join a livestock market and its stray property, while compensation and substitution offer a regulated alternative to uncompensated loss.

parent_channels.name: Household Continuity and Protected Belonging
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Kinship is produced and maintained through gestation, nurture, marriage, covenant, and defense of household boundaries.

subchannels.active_motifs: close kinship `ر ح م:B002/m01`; maintaining kin ties `ر ح م:B002/m02`; stepchild `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; foster caregiver `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; progressive child-rearing `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; guardianship `ق و م:B004/m01`
subchannels.name: Kinship, Fosterage, and Continuing Care
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child belongs to a network of blood and acquired kin whose caregiver assumes responsibility for nurture and continuity.
subchannels.synthesis: Blood relation supplies one form of belonging, fosterage supplies another, and guardianship turns both into continuing obligations. Progressive nurture is the operation that converts formal relation into lived care.

subchannels.active_motifs: the womb as organ `ر ح م:B003/m01`; the womb as seedbed and vessel `ر ح م:B003/m02`; recently delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; freshness or newness after emergence `ر ب ب:B009/m02`; postpartum uterine pain `ر ح م:B004/m01`
subchannels.name: Gestation, Recent Birth, and Postpartum Vulnerability
subchannels.scene_or_process: The womb contains developing offspring, birth produces a newly delivered mother and new life, and the postpartum body remains vulnerable to pain or retained afterbirth.
subchannels.synthesis: The womb supplies enclosure and generative function, newness marks successful emergence, and the recently delivered ewe embodies the maternal participant. Postpartum pain preserves the bodily cost that follows the transition.

subchannels.active_motifs: marriage contract `م ل ك:B004/m01`; bride conveyed to her husband `ه د ي:B006/m01`; kinship relation `ر ح م:B002/m01`; affectionate gift `ه د ي:B004/m01`
subchannels.name: Marriage and Bride-Conveyance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marriage contract establishes a new household relation and the bride is formally conveyed to her spouse, accompanied by affectionate transfer.
subchannels.synthesis: Contract creates the relation, conveyance enacts the transition between households, kinship names the resulting bond, and the gift supplies a reciprocal social gesture around the transfer.

subchannels.active_motifs: covenant and protected association `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; protected refugee or bearer of safe conduct `ه د ي:B007/m01`; certification or delegated oath `د ي ن:B007/m01`; indemnity `غ ي ر:B002/m01`; naming and legal identification `س م و:B005/m01`
subchannels.name: Covenant, Refuge, and Legal Protection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named outsider or dependent receives protected standing through covenant, certification, and a rule of compensatory redress.
subchannels.synthesis: Naming identifies the protected person, covenant establishes the relation, certification makes it publicly actionable, and indemnity defines the consequence of violating that protection.

subchannels.active_motifs: protective jealousy over family `غ ي ر:B004/m01`; frowning irritability `غ ض ب:B007/m01`; bodily strength and firmness `ع ب د:B007/m01`; kin group or community `ق و م:B001/m01`; close kinship `ر ح م:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ` (`ر ح م`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ي ر`, `غ ض ب`)
subchannels.name: Protective Jealousy and Household Defense
subchannels.scene_or_process: Attachment to household and kin activates vigilance, bodily firmness, and visible anger against intrusion.
subchannels.synthesis: Kinship supplies the protected circle, jealousy detects a threatened boundary, firmness supplies defensive capacity, and the frown externalizes readiness to resist.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The mercy root opens into womb and blood relation, while guidance becomes both bride-conveyance and the protected status of a refugee under covenant.

parent_channels.name: Herd Formation, Wildlife, and Dispersal
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal life is organized by gathering, classification, reproduction, leadership, pursuit, and scattering.

subchannels.active_motifs: wild-cattle herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; herd of wild donkeys `ع و ن:B006/m01`; livestock wealth `ن ع م:B005/m01`; middle-aged animal `ع و ن:B002/m01`; leading animal followed by the herd `م ل ك:B008/m01`; ownerless stray `ض ل ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.name: Herd, Livestock, and the Stray Margin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Domestic and wild animals gather into recognizable herds, are classified and led, and can fall outside the group as ownerless strays.
subchannels.synthesis: Species and age make animals classifiable, gathering makes them a herd, and the lead animal provides internal order. The stray defines the boundary case where an animal loses both group placement and known ownership.

subchannels.active_motifs: hunters setting out `س م و:B006/m01`; flight, rout, and dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; scattered groups and diverging roads `ع ب د:B010/m01`; a human company `ق و م:B001/m01`; loss of a thing from its holder `ض ل ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.name: Hunt, Flight, and Scattered Routes
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hunters set out, the pursued group takes flight, and a once-coherent body disperses into people, animals, or routes going in different directions.
subchannels.synthesis: Departure initiates pursuit, flight breaks collective formation, and diverging roads spatialize the resulting separation. Loss names the outcome from the perspective of the group or holder that can no longer retain what fled.

subchannels.active_motifs: womb as generative vessel `ر ح م:B003/m02`; ostrich `ن ع م:B006/m01`; falcon or hawk `ع ل م:B006/m01`; male hyena `ع ل م:B007/m01`; recently delivered ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; exposed ownerless animal `ض ل ل:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ` (`ر ح م`); 1:2 `رَبِّ` and `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ر ب ب`, `ع ل م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` and `ٱلضَّآلِّينَ` (`ن ع م`, `ض ل ل`)
subchannels.name: Wildlife Generation and Exposure
subchannels.scene_or_process: New animal life emerges from reproductive enclosure into an open field populated by birds, herd animals, and predators.
subchannels.synthesis: The womb and recently delivered ewe supply generation, the ostrich supplies a large bird of the open field, and falcon and hyena supply predatory animal classes. The stray marks the vulnerability that follows emergence beyond enclosure and custody.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The animal field ranges from owned livestock and coherent herds to ostrich, falcon, hyena, and ownerless strays, with womb imagery joining wildlife to generation.

parent_channels.name: Habitation, Water, and the Living Landscape
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Habitation becomes viable when authority, residence, water, weather, and vegetation converge into a sustaining place.

subchannels.active_motifs: city as the place where authority is obeyed `د ي ن:B006/m01`; residence or settled place `ق و م:B006/m01`; the village or locality of Anah `ع و ن:B008/m01`; a place pleasant for settlement `ن ع م:B011/m01`; finding a person or place satisfactory `ح م د:B002/m01`; continued residence `ر ب ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.name: Governed and Pleasant Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community establishes residence in a governed place, finds the site suitable, and remains there.
subchannels.synthesis: Authority gives the settlement civic form, residence supplies continuity, and suitability supplies the inhabitants' positive judgment of the place. The named locality makes the scene geographically concrete.

subchannels.active_motifs: abundant fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; sea or water-rich well `ع ل م:B005/m01`; water that secures command of camp and livelihood `م ل ك:B007/m01`; sustenance of life `ق و م:B009/m02`; irrigation of land and people `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
subchannels.name: Water-Secured Encampment and Livelihood
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community locates abundant collected water, controls its encampment through that resource, and sustains livelihood by storing and distributing it.
subchannels.synthesis: The well or collected water supplies the resource, control of water makes encampment possible, irrigation extends it into the surrounding land, and livelihood is the resulting stable state.

subchannels.active_motifs: overhead sky `س م و:B004/m01`; cloud and rain `س م و:B004/m02`; layered raincloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; persistent cloud or wind `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; gentle south wind `ن ع م:B009/m01`; enduring green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; old established palm `ع و ن:B004/m01`; irrigation `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
subchannels.name: Sky, Rain, Wind, and Enduring Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: The overhead sky forms layered rainclouds, weather persists, a gentle southern wind moves through, and watered vegetation remains green.
subchannels.synthesis: Layered cloud gathers the water-bearing material, persistence and wind describe weather movement, irrigation delivers water to the ground, and green plant and old palm display growth across both season and duration.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: The field moves from a city defined by obedience into a camp secured by stored water, then upward to layered clouds, persistent rain, gentle wind, and enduring plants.

parent_channels.name: Structural Support and Working Materials
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Stability is produced by cohesive material, load-bearing members, mechanical parts, and treatments that bind, coat, or repair.

subchannels.active_motifs: material cohesion and strength `م ل ك:B001/m01`; mainstay of an affair `م ل ك:B005/m01`; structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`; upright tool or furniture member `ق و م:B012/m01`; firm knot or joint `ر ب ب:B016/m02`; strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`
subchannels.name: Cohesion, Mainstay, and Upright Members
subchannels.scene_or_process: A structure or undertaking remains standing because material cohesion, a firm joint, and upright supporting members carry its load.
subchannels.synthesis: Cohesion binds the material, the knot or joint fixes connected parts, upright members transfer load, and the mainstay names the same sustaining function at the scale of an entire undertaking.

subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich-shaped well timber `ن ع م:B007/m01`; upright mechanical component `ق و م:B012/m01`; water-rich well `ع ل م:B005/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; water securing the camp `م ل ك:B007/m01`
subchannels.name: Well and Water-Lifting Assembly
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upright timber and working components are arranged over a water source so a settlement can draw and control water.
subchannels.synthesis: The well supplies the setting and resource, the upright timber and associated standing part supply the mechanism, and control of the lifted water supplies the functional outcome.

subchannels.active_motifs: thick syrup or oily residue `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; repair or preservation with that concentrate `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; kneading into cohesion `م ل ك:B001/m02`; tarred or coated vessel, ship, or animal `ع ب د:B005/m02`; repair of travel gear `غ ي ر:B001/m03`; softened material or food `ن ع م:B002/m01`
subchannels.name: Thickening, Coating, and Repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thick material is worked to cohesion, applied as a coating or preservative, and used to repair containers, food, medicine, or transport surfaces.
subchannels.synthesis: Kneading and concentration produce workable consistency, coating applies the material to a surface, and repair or preservation supplies the outcome. Softness and cohesion are complementary target states rather than opposing qualities.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Abstract mainstay and firmness resolve into wall cohesion, knots, table or well parts, kneaded material, thick concentrate, and coated transport surfaces.

parent_channels.name: Bodily Integrity, Posture, and Injury
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A living body is read through stance, proportion, strength, visible markers, pain, and loss of function.

subchannels.active_motifs: bodily rising and upright stance `ق و م:B002/m01`; stature and bodily proportion `ق و م:B011/m01`; strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`; balanced mature build `ع و ن:B005/m01`; bodily cohesion `م ل ك:B001/m01`; thick, strongly colored body `غ ض ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:4 `مَٰلِكِ` (`م ل ك`); 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` and `نَسْتَعِينُ` (`ع ب د`, `ع و ن`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ض ب`)
subchannels.name: Upright Stature and Balanced Strength
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body rises upright, displays proportion and firmness, and sustains its posture through balanced mature strength.
subchannels.synthesis: Rising supplies posture, stature supplies visible proportion, and cohesion, solidity, and mature balance supply the forces that maintain it. Thickness and strong coloration render bodily vigor externally perceptible.

subchannels.active_motifs: cleft in the upper lip `ع ل م:B004/m01`; swelling around the eye `غ ض ب:B006/m01`; pain lodged in an organ `ق و م:B019/m01`; postpartum uterine pain `ر ح م:B004/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:1 and 1:3 `ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ` / `ٱلرَّحِيمِ` (`ر ح م`); 1:2 `ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ` (`ع ل م`); 1:6 `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ق و م`); 1:7 `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`غ ض ب`)
subchannels.name: Lesion, Swelling, and Localized Pain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A specific body part bears a visible lesion or swelling and becomes the site of persistent pain.
subchannels.synthesis: Cleft and swelling provide visible signs, while localized pain provides the felt state. The postpartum uterus extends the same diagnostic scene to an internal reproductive organ.

subchannels.active_motifs: intact-looking eye without sight `ق و م:B021/m01`; disease in a sheep's legs `ق و م:B020/m01`; dull, weak, heavy person `ه د ي:B009/m01`; exhausted mount unable to continue `ع ب د:B011/m01`; eye delight and visual refreshment `ن ع م:B013/m01`; eye swelling `غ ض ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:6 `ٱهْدِنَا` and `ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ` (`ه د ي`, `ق و م`); 1:7 `أَنْعَمْتَ` and `ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ` (`ن ع م`, `غ ض ب`)
subchannels.name: Preserved Appearance with Failed Function
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or limb remains visibly present yet fails in sight, gait, strength, or forward movement.
subchannels.synthesis: The blind but intact eye most clearly separates appearance from operation. Diseased legs, bodily heaviness, and an exhausted mount repeat that separation in movement, while eye delight supplies the contrasting state of restored visual ease.

subchannels.active_motifs: pubic hair `ع و ن:B007/m01`; womb as reproductive organ `ر ح م:B003/m01`; middle age `ع و ن:B002/m01`; mature balanced strength `ع و ن:B005/m01`; a distinguishing bodily mark `ع ل م:B002/m03`
subchannels.name: Bodily Markers of Maturity and Reproduction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily marks, sexual maturity, reproductive capacity, and age make a living body classifiable.
subchannels.synthesis: Visible hair and marks supply external indicators, the womb supplies reproductive capacity, and age with mature strength locates the body within a life stage. Classification emerges from the conjunction of form, function, and development.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Uprightness and firmness describe healthy stature, yet the same standing field also holds an intact-looking blind eye, diseased legs, swollen tissue, and a body halted by weakness.

parent_channels.name: Conflict, Anger, and Defensive Order
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Opposition escalates through rivalry and anger into combat, retaliation, defense, defeat, or compensatory settlement.

subchannels.active_motifs: rivalry and competitive matching `س م و:B007/m01`; war fought repeatedly `ع و ن:B003/m01`; mutual resistance and combat `ق و م:B014/m01`; defiance and opposition `غ ض ب:B003/m01`; resolve and rising to action `ق و م:B003/m01`; the publicly praised champion `ح م د:B003/m01`
subchannels.name: Rivalry, Resistance, and Repeated War
subchannels.scene_or_process: Competitors seek superiority, rise against one another, and turn repeated opposition into organized combat.
subchannels.synthesis: Competition supplies the initiating comparison, resolve converts comparison into action, resistance supplies reciprocal force, and repeated war stabilizes opposition as an enduring social frame. Praise records the reputation won within that contest.

subchannels.active_motifs: intense anger `غ ض ب:B001/m01`; retaliatory wrath `غ ض ب:B001/m02`; pride and hot resentment `ع ب د:B008/m01`; grief and regret after loss `ع ب د:B008/m02`; anger for the living or mourning by the dead `غ ض ب:B002/m01`; blood left without vengeance `ض ل ل:B003/m02`; indemnity in place of retaliation `غ ي ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 1:5 `نَعْبُدُ` (`ع ب د`); 1:7 `غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ ... ٱلضَّآلِّينَ` (`غ ي ر`, `غ ض ب`, `ض ل ل`)
subchannels.name: Anger, Mourning, Vengeance, and Redress
subchannels.scene_or_process: Injury or loss provokes anger and grief, which can seek retaliatory vengeance or be redirected into compensatory settlement.
subchannels.synthesis: Injury activates anger, death or irreversible loss introduces grief, and retaliation offers one outcome. Indemnity supplies an alternate endpoint in which compensation replaces vengeance and prevents blood from remaining without redress.

subchannels.active_motifs: defeat and dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; scattered groups and routes `ع ب د:B010/m01`; loss from a holder `ض ل ل:B003/m01`; mutual confrontation `ق و م:B014/m01`; hunters setting out in pursuit `س م و:B006/m01`
subchannels.name: Rout and Collective Dispersal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group under pressure loses formation, turns away, and scatters along divergent routes.
subchannels.synthesis: Confrontation supplies pressure, pursuit supplies direction, defeat breaks cohesion, and divergent routes express the spatial result. Loss describes the same event from the perspective of the former group.

subchannels.active_motifs: hard folded hide used as a shield `غ ض ب:B008/m01`; cutting and penetrating sword `ص ر ط:B003/m01`; hard layered rock `غ ض ب:B004/m01`; bodily strength and solidity `ع ب د:B007/m01`
subchannels.name: Hardness, Shielding, and the Cutting Edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A defender combines bodily strength with hard natural or worked material to resist a penetrating blade.
subchannels.synthesis: The sword supplies penetrating force, the shield supplies a worked resistant surface, rock supplies the material analogy for hardness, and bodily solidity supplies the agent capable of holding the defense.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Competitive striving becomes repeated war and mutual resistance, while anger over loss can terminate either in vengeance or in indemnity; hardness also becomes literal defensive material.
